what_it_is.prose: The Vajra Sentinel Counter-Drone System is an AI-powered counter-UAS platform developed by Big Bang Boom Solutions Pvt Ltd (BBBS) of Chennai. The system uses passive radio-frequency (RF) sensor technology to detect and neutralize commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) drones, with claimed near-zero false alarm rate and MIL-SPEC 810G environmental compliance. The Indian Air Force issued a Request for Proposal (RFP) for the Anti-Drone Defence System (ADDS) in June 2022. The Indian Ministry of Defence signed a ₹200 crore contract with BBBS on 8 March 2024 under the iDEX (Innovations for Defence Excellence) framework — a joint IAF and Army order — making BBBS what press coverage termed 'India's first defence dragon' (the highest-valued defence-tech startup, having raised $31.65 million across three funding rounds including a ₹250 crore Series B in September 2024 at 15x return to early investors). The first lot of Vajra Sentinel systems was delivered to the Indian Air Force around May 2025, with delivery accelerated in response to Operation Sindoor. The Vajra product family includes the Sentinel C-UAS (the flagship), Vajra Shot (handheld anti-drone gun used by the National Security Guard), Vajra Spot (AESA drone detection radar), Vajra Shield (jammers), Vajra Sight/Strike/Slayer (kinetic effectors), and Vajra Scan/Sense (detection systems). BBBS is distinct from Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL), the maker of the Bhargavastra counter-drone system (Atlas slug cus-004) — the two are separate Indian counter-drone OEMs. The Atlas register previously conflated BBBS with Bhargavastra; see REGISTER_TICKETS.md ticket P0-BHARGAVASTRA-MAKER for the full conflict resolution.

deployments_procurement.summary: The Indian Air Force issued an RFP for the Anti-Drone Defence System (ADDS) in June 2022. faq.question: Is Vajra Sentinel the same as Bhargavastra?
faq.answer: No. Vajra Sentinel is made by Big Bang Boom Solutions (BBBS) of Chennai. Bhargavastra is made by Solar Defence and Aerospace Limited (SDAL) of Nagpur. The Atlas register previously conflated these two distinct Indian counter-drone products — see REGISTER_TICKETS.md ticket P0-BHARGAVASTRA-MAKER. Vajra Sentinel uses AI-powered passive RF technology and has a ₹200 cr MoD contract (March 2024); Bhargavastra is a micro-missile hard-kill system under the Indian Army's Make-II programme with induction targeted end-2026.

faq.question: What is the Vajra product family?
faq.answer: The Vajra product family includes the Sentinel C-UAS (the flagship, ₹200 cr MoD deal), Vajra Shot (handheld anti-drone gun used by the NSG), Vajra Spot (AESA drone detection radar), Vajra Shield X and S (jammers), Vajra Super Shot (jammer), Vajra Sight/Strike/Slayer (kinetic effectors), and Vajra Scan X/S and Sense (detection systems). BBBS also produces an EW portfolio (Cnidaria, Aqua Tether, Yudhikshana, Agni, Quell, TIC Drone) and AI-powered Command & Control systems.

faq.question: Was Vajra Sentinel deployed during Operation Sindoor?
faq.answer: The first lot of Vajra Sentinel systems was delivered to the Indian Air Force around May 2025, with delivery accelerated in response to Operation Sindoor. The delivery timing suggests operational use during Op Sindoor, but no independent combat-use confirmation has been made public. The Op Sindoor deployment of the BEL IDDIS system (Atlas slug cus-001) is confirmed by BEL and PIB.
